stories.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
stories.description: Define persistent schema for bearer tokens including token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, revoked_at, parent_token_id (for rotation lineage), and scopes. Implement MongoDB collection and access patterns consistent with existing GPTReader data access.

stories.title: Token Issuance and Rotation Core Logic
stories.description: Implement secure token issuance and rotation logic including cryptographic token generation, hashing before storage, parent-child linkage for rotated tokens, and automatic invalidation of prior tokens upon rotation.

stories.title: Token Expiration Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement expiration handling including TTL calculation, validation checks against expires_at, and optional background cleanup of expired tokens. Ensure expired tokens are consistently rejected during authentication.

stories.title: Token Management API Endpoints
stories.description: Expose internal/admin API endpoints for token issuance, rotation, and revocation. Ensure endpoints follow existing FastAPI patterns and integrate with auth layer while restricting access via scoped permissions.
